labels: Nearest Neighbor is the Orange class

layout.arrangement: Title centered at top inside a gray header band; slide number '44' in a yellow circle at top-right corner. Below the header, two side-by-side scatter-plot panels inside a thin red-bordered frame: left panel shows three clusters of colored dots plus a red query point with a '?'; right panel shows the same data with lines drawn from the red query point to all other points and the nearest neighbor highlighted. Each panel has a red caption centered beneath it.

regions.name: header band
regions.content: Title text 'Nearest Neighbors (NN) Example' with 'Nearest Neighbors' in dark red and '(NN) Example' in blue; yellow circle with '44' at far right

regions.name: left plot panel
regions.content: Scatter plot with L-shaped red axes; green cluster upper-left, cyan cluster upper-right, orange/tan cluster bottom-center, single red dot with '?' in middle; small gray arrow/cursor near center

regions.name: right plot panel
regions.content: Same scatter data with thin pink lines radiating from the red query point to every other point; nearest orange point circled in yellow with dashed outline; small red arrowheads on the lines

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates in large bold text (red + blue). The two plot panels are the main visual mass, equal size. Red captions are medium-bold. The red query dot and yellow highlight circle draw the eye within the plots.

visual_elements.description: Left scatter plot: L-shaped dark-red axes (vertical axis up, horizontal axis right, arrowheads at ends, no ticks or labels). Three clusters of filled circles with dark outlines: ~11 green dots upper-left, ~9 cyan dots upper-right, ~6 orange/tan dots bottom-center. One larger red filled dot near center with a dark red '?' to its right. A small gray curved arrow/cursor sits just above-left of the red dot.

Right scatter plot: same axes and same three clusters (green, cyan, orange) plus the red query dot. Thin light-pink lines connect the red dot to every other point, each with a small red arrowhead pointing at the target point. The closest orange point (just below-left of the red dot) is highlighted with a yellow fill and a dashed dark-red circle around it, indicating it is the nearest neighbor.
Thin dark-red rectangular border framing the entire content area below the header band
Yellow circle with dark outline containing the slide number '44' in dark text

imagery: No photographs; only vector scatter-plot dots, connecting lines, arrows, and a yellow slide-number badge
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is large and bold, two-colored (dark red for 'Nearest Neighbors', blue for '(NN) Example'). Captions under plots are bold dark red, smaller than title. The '?' annotation is dark red italic-ish. Slide number is small dark text in a yellow circle.
animation_state: Both panels fully rendered; no partial build visible. The right panel appears to be the 'answer' state of the left panel's question.
